test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. W is to the immediate left of X, who is sitting opposite Y. If V is second to the left of Y and exactly opposite U, what is the sitting location of Z?
solution: Six persons: U, V, W, X, Y, and Z The logic followed here is: **1.** Six persons are sitting around a circular table facing the center. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2075cb089a7f6fd4fe58b92e51cb61824ac6632e05b414ee3562b5925920c143.png] **2.** W is to the immediate left of X, who is sitting opposite Y.
